# HDR regression fixtures

`apple-legacy-macos26.jpg` is a synthetic 64 × 32 JPEG generated by the
`fixture()` function in `../../hdr_image_tests.mm` on macOS 26.6.1 Intel.
It contains an Apple auxiliary gain map with `HDRToneMap` element metadata
under the Adobe gain-map namespace, plus an Apple auxiliary type declaration.
ImageIO also synthesizes an ISO dictionary when reading it. It must remain an
Apple legacy input; namespace presence and the synthesized dictionary alone
must not send it to the Ultra HDR decoder.

The image has no camera or personal content. Keep these original bytes so the
regression does not depend on the host Core Image writer version.
